project: FP8 Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding on Systolic Arrays
target_hardware: Cloud TPU v7 (Ironwood / tpu7x, ~192 GB HBM3E/chip, 4614 TFLOPS FP8, 7.38 TB/s HBM3E)

stage_a_scaffold_host.notes: Repository scaffolded and host-math/wire-parser verified on non-TPU workstation. Zero TPU metrics fabricated. Ready for Stage B takeover on Cloud TPU v7 VM.

phase1_baseline_serving.gate_command: bash -c 'source scripts/env_common.sh && cleanup_stale_tpu_processes && python3 scripts/download_and_verify_models.py && pytest -v -s tests/test_baseline_serving.py'

phase3_spec_matrix_and_xprof.gate_command: bash -c 'source scripts/env_common.sh && cleanup_stale_tpu_processes && python3 benchmarks/run_spec_matrix.py --smoke && python3 benchmarks/run_spec_matrix.py --full && python3 scripts/parse_xprof.py'

phase4_roofline_and_submission.gate_command: bash -c 'source scripts/env_common.sh && python3 benchmarks/fit_roofline_model.py && python3 scripts/generate_final_reports.py && bash scripts/run_all.sh'
